blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.
blocks.zh: Omnimodule大型语言模型(Omni-LLMS)在观测连续的视听流的同时,越来越有望为用户提供帮助. 然而,现有的评价对这些模式如何可靠地将流证据和用户需要与及时、持续的干预措施联系起来,提供了有限的见解。 我们引入\textbf{Omni-InteractScope},这个基准为1,479个人类附加说明的、经过交叉审查的相互作用,8个工作组共有1,790个时间目标。 它将输入模式、事件触发器、干预类型和用户需求联系起来,包括事件定时工具引用和无查询协助,以及通知、警告、状态跟踪和连续答复。 我们关于拟议基准的实验结果揭示了当前Omni-LLMs的三个关键局限:(1)\textbf{及时工具引用仍然不可靠}:所有12个被评价的模型对最多40个工具调用目标作出实时第一次响应,联合计时和工具的准确度达到最多32.0分。 (2)\textbf-weery-free reminers仍然覆盖不足}:所有被评价的模型在免问提醒中实现的及时参考-目标召回比在各自目标集中衡量的明确问题要低。 提醒提醒永远不会超过23.0分 (3)\textbf{端到端的制导覆盖范围仍然有限}:9个型号没有完全覆盖26个制导序列,其余3个型号只覆盖每个导导序列一到三个. 定向控制进一步表明,仅靠工具调用得分并不能确定事件底线,提醒覆盖取决于响应历史和频率. 这些结果促使开发和评价流动助理,以便及时采取行动,根据一般用户需要采取主动行动,并涵盖整个反应序列。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) such as GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-Omni, and Qwen3-Omni bring joint audiovisual understanding into conversational systems ( Hurst et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . Emerging streaming systems extend this ability to deciding when to speak, remain silent, or invoke tools ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) . For an assistant observing a changing environment, these decisions must serve a user’s ongoing needs: retrieve information when a requested event occurs, relay a relevant sound to a user with hearing impairment, or provide continue guidance as an activity unfolds (see Figure 1 ). Useful assistance therefore requires connecting perceptual evidence to what intervention is needed, when it is useful, and whether further responses remain necessary .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(Omni-LLMS),如GPT-4o、Qun2.5-Omni和Qun3-Omni,将联合视听理解带入对话系统(Hurst等人,2024年;Xu等人,2025年a); 徐等人,2025b.). 新兴流体系统将这种能力扩展至决定何时说话、保持沉默或援引工具(Chen等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年b;ByteDance种子,2026年)。 对于观察不断变化的环境的助理来说,这些决定必须满足用户的持续需要:在所请求的事件发生时检索信息,向有听力障碍的用户转发相关声音,或在活动展开时继续提供指导(见图1)。 因此,有益的援助需要将概念证据与需要何种干预联系起来,如果干预是有用的,以及是否还需要进一步的反应。

blocks.en: Evaluation has progressed from video comprehension toward interactive assistance. Early works, such as Video-MME and LongVideoBench, assess understanding of supplied videos ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , while StreamingBench and OVO-Bench restrict observations to available stream prefixes and test responses to unfolding events ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) . Recent benchmarks further evaluate multimodal turn-taking, audio-dependent proactivity, and event-triggered response windows ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) . OmniAssistBench organizes goal-oriented assistance along predefined interaction paths ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . StreamArena jointly evaluates perception, retrospection, proactivity, and tool utilization over hour-scale causal streams ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Assistance without an event-specific question is also studied in VIABench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 summarizes this progression in terms of stream access and intervention objectives. Section 2 provides a comprehensive discussion of related work.
blocks.zh: 评价从视频理解发展到互动援助。 早期的作品,如Video-MME和LongVideo Bench,评估了对所提供视频的理解(Fu等人,2025年;Wu等人,2024年),而Streaming Bench和OVO-Bench则将观测限制在已有的溪流前缀和对正在发生的事件的测试响应(Lin等人,2026年;Niu等人,2025年). 最近的基准进一步评价了多式转向、依赖音频的主动性和事件触发响应窗口(Wang等人,2025b;Zhao等人,2026b;Lu等人,2026b)。 OmniAsist Bench沿着预先确定的互动路径(Sun等人,2026年)组织面向目标的援助. StreamArena联合评价了对小时因果流的认知、回顾、积极性和工具利用情况(Zhang等人,2026年)。 VIA Bench(Liu等人,2026年)也研究了没有特定事件问题的援助。 表1总结了这一进展的流量和干预目标。 第2节全面讨论了相关工作。

blocks.en: An assistant’s obligation extends beyond the content of its next answer. A specified event can require a tool call at a useful moment, a general assistance need can require intervention without an event-specific question, and a standing request can require further responses after an initial answer. Evaluating these requirements together calls for explicit links between user context, response content, valid timing, and successive targets. It also calls for distinguishing scene evidence from request priors and target coverage from the opportunities allowed to respond. This combination makes it possible to examine both whether an intervention obligation is fulfilled and which evaluation conditions shape the result.
blocks.zh: 助理的义务超出了其下一个答复的内容。 特定事件可能需要在有用的时刻发出一个工具呼叫,一般援助需求可能需要在没有特定事件问题的情况下进行干预,长期请求可能需要在初步答复后作出进一步答复。 要一并评估这些要求,就需要在用户背景、反应内容、有效时间和连续目标之间明确联系。 它还要求区分现场证据与请求前科,以及目标覆盖面与允许答复的机会。 这种组合使得有可能审查干预义务是否得到履行,以及哪些评价条件决定了结果。

blocks.en: We introduce Omni-InteractScope , a benchmark organized around the relationship between stream evidence, user needs, and required interventions. It contains 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets. The assistance panel draws on 207 self-recorded first-person videos. The benchmark links four dimensions: input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs. Eight task groups span tool invocation, notifications, warnings, cumulative-state tracking, temporal conditions, nonverbal cues, continuous responses, and impairment assistance. Each target specifies response content and a valid time or interval. Interactions with multiple targets record the responses required after an initial answer. This organization supports evaluating both individual interventions and coverage of continuing obligations within a shared resource.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Omni-InteractScope, 围绕流证据、用户需求以及所需干预之间的关系, 它包含1,479个附加说明的、经过交叉审查的相互作用,有1,790个时间目标。 协助小组借鉴了207个自录的第一人称视频. 基准将四个方面联系起来:输入模式、事件触发、干预类型和用户需求。 八个工作组涉及工具引用、通知、警告、累积状态跟踪、时间条件、非语言提示、持续反应和减值援助。 每个目标都指定了响应内容和有效时间或间隔. 与多个目标的互动记录了初步答复后所需的答复。 本组织支持评价个人干预措施和共享资源内持续义务的涵盖范围。

blocks.en: Within this broad coverage, we focus on two complementary demands of proactive interaction. Tool invocation requires selecting the appropriate tool and acting when a user-specified event occurs. Query-free assistance requires recognizing when a general user need warrants a reminder without an event-specific query. Paired controls examine the roles of scene evidence and response policy, while successive targets assess whether the assistant delivers the further responses required as an interaction unfolds.
blocks.zh: 在这一广泛范围内,我们侧重于主动互动的两个相辅相成的要求。 工具引用需要选择适当的工具,并在出现用户指定事件时采取行动。 无查询协助需要识别当普通用户需要不需要特定事件查询的提醒时. Paired控制审查现场证据和反应政策的作用,而连续的目标评估助理是否在互动过程中提供所需的进一步反应。

blocks.en: Evaluation across 12 models reveals substantial limitations in both timely intervention and sustained assistance. Every evaluated model produces an on-time first response for at most 40% of tool-invocation targets, and joint accuracy reaches at most 32.0%. Timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders never exceeds 23.0%. Although guidance-step recall reaches 51.7%, nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and no model covers more than three.
blocks.zh: 对12个模式的评价显示,及时干预和持续援助都存在重大局限性。 每个被评价的模型最多能产生40%的工具调用目标的实时第一次响应,联合精确度最多达到32.0%. 在无查询提醒中及时调用参考-目标调用从未超过23.0%. 虽然制导步骤召回率达到51.7%,但9种型号完全覆盖了26个制导序列中的任何一个,没有一种型号覆盖3个以上.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce Omni-InteractScope, a comprehensive benchmark for timely and sustained omnimodal intervention. It comprises 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions across eight task groups, with 1,790 targets specifying what to produce and when, including successive responses under continuing user needs. • We provide focused evaluation of event-timed action and query-free initiative through 200 tool-invocation targets and 122 query-free reminders. Our diagnostics distinguish tool choice from timing and test whether invocation scores depend on scene evidence. Paired controls further examine how explicit event cues, response scheduling, history, and response frequency affect coverage on the same
reminder targets. • We perform a comprehensive evaluation of 12 multimodal models, providing empirical insights into timing, query-free assistance, and sequence coverage, exposing gaps between tool selection and timely action, question answering, and query-free reminders, and step coverage and complete guidance.

blocks.en: Video-MME and LongVideoBench evaluate comprehension of supplied videos ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . StreamingBench and OVO-Bench restrict observations to available stream prefixes and test responses to unfolding events ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) . OmniMMI and OmniPro extend evaluation to multimodal interaction and audio-dependent proactivity ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . These works motivate causal evaluation of response content and timing. Omni-InteractScope records the intervention required by a user need, including targets that remain after an initial response.

blocks.en: ToolBench and API-Bank evaluate tool-use plans and executable calls ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . StreamArena brings tool utilization and proactivity into hour-scale causal streams, including external search and answer integration ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Our event-timed tool invocation (T1) setting evaluates tool identity and invocation timing, with controls that distinguish request priors from scene evidence. Omni-DuplexEval includes continuous descriptions and event-conditioned reminders, and OmniAssistBench evaluates assistance along predefined paths ( He et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . We retain successive targets within each interaction and report both individual-target and complete-guidance coverage. Table 1 separates these objectives from multiple independent questions about the same video.

blocks.en: 3.1 Designing for timely and sustained intervention
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 设计及时和持续干预

blocks.en: The benchmark unit is an interaction: a video and audio stream, user context, and one or more reference interventions. Each intervention is a target specifying the required response and its reference time or valid interval. For a continuing request, the interaction retains successive targets in temporal order.
blocks.zh: 基准单元是一个互动:视频和音频流,用户背景,以及一个或多个参考干预. 每项干预措施都是指明所需反应及其参考时间或有效间隔的目标。 对于持续的请求,互动按时间顺序保留了连续的目标.

blocks.en: We organize this unit along four linked dimensions. Input modalities describe the available video, scene audio, and user context conveyed through text, speech, or image attachments. Event triggers describe the evidence or condition associated with a response, such as an object appearing, a sound, an accumulated count, or elapsed time. Intervention types specify what the assistant should produce: an answer, notification, warning, tool call, or successive commentary or guidance. User needs determine why that intervention matters, through an explicit request or a general visual- or hearing-assistance instruction.
blocks.zh: 我们按照四个相互关联的方面组织这个单位。 输入模式描述现有的视频,场景音频,以及通过文本,语音,或图像附件传递的用户上下文. 事件触发器描述与响应相关的证据或条件,如出现物体,声音,累积计数,或过期时间. 干预类型规定助理应产生什么:答复、通知、警告、工具呼叫或连续的评论或指导。 用户需要通过明确的请求或一般的视觉或听力协助指示,确定干预为何重要。

blocks.en: Together, these dimensions connect stream evidence and user context to the interventions an assistant should provide. The eight task groups organize these requirements into a comprehensive evaluation of response content, timing, and coverage, encompassing both individual interventions and successive responses under continuing user needs.
blocks.zh: 这些层面共同将流程证据和用户背景与助理应提供的干预措施联系起来。 八个工作组将这些要求组织成对响应内容、时间安排和覆盖面的全面评价,包括个别干预和用户持续需要的连续响应。

blocks.en: 3.2 Task coverage and focal settings
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 任务覆盖面和焦点设置

blocks.en: Seven task groups contain 1,180 interactions with different monitoring demands. Event notification (T2) asks the assistant to report a specified occurrence, while risk/error interjection (T3) calls for a warning when an unsafe or incorrect action occurs. Nonverbal/workflow cues (T6) connect a gesture or workflow event to the requested response, including matching a gesture to a query image. Cumulative-state tracking (T4) uses earlier observations to interpret current events. Temporal conditions (T5) introduce obligations governed by elapsed time. Continuous responses (T7) extend a standing request across successive commentary or translation segments.
blocks.zh: 7个工作组包含1 180个与不同监测需求的互动。 事件通知(T2)要求助手报告指定的事件,而风险/误射(T3)则要求在发生不安全或不正确的行动时发出警告。 非语言/工作流程提示(T6)将手势或工作流程事件与请求的响应连接起来,包括将手势与查询图像匹配. 累积状态跟踪(T4)利用早期的观测来解释时事. 临时条件(T5)引入了受时间所限的义务。 持续答复(T7)将长期请求延伸至各评注或翻译部分。

blocks.en: T1 tests whether a model invokes the appropriate tool when a specified event occurs. A request can indicate which tool to use before the stream establishes when to act. Each target therefore specifies a tool-name set and invocation time. Evaluation covers these requirements, with arguments and downstream execution outside its scope.
blocks.zh: T1测试一个模型在发生指定事件时是否引用了适当的工具. 请求可以指明在流确定何时行动之前要使用哪种工具. 因此,每个目标都指定一个工具名称集和引用时间。 评价涵盖这些要求,其范围以外还有论据和下游执行。

blocks.en: The 299-interaction impairment-assistance panel (T8) covers visual- and hearing-assistance needs. Query-free reminders (T8-A) require identifying useful interventions under a general instruction, without an event-specific question. Audiovisual questions (T8-B) test answering explicit requests, while multi-step guidance (T8-C) tests successive responses along recorded trajectories. Both T7 and T8-C retain ordered targets within each interaction to represent continuing response obligations. Appendix A.2 details the category boundaries.
blocks.zh: 299个互动障碍援助小组(T8)涵盖视觉和听力援助需求。 免问提醒(T8-A)要求在一般指示下确定有用的干预,而不涉及特定事件的问题。 视听问题(T8-B)测试回答明确的请求,而多步制导(T8-C)则按照记录的轨迹连续测试回复. T7和T8-C在每次互动中都保留有秩序的目标,以表示持续的反应义务。 附录A.2详细列出了类别界限。

blocks.en: 3.3 Data construction and annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据构建和注释

blocks.en: The benchmark combines 905 online video records for explicit-request tasks with 207 self-recorded first-person video records for impairment assistance. It spans indoor, outdoor, and digital-screen settings, with QA text approximately balanced between English and Chinese (744 and 735 interactions, respectively). The 1,479 interactions contain 1,790 targets, with multiple targets in 163 interactions. Appendix A details task counts, scene and trigger distributions, duration statistics, and source provenance, including repeated source identities among video records.
blocks.zh: 该基准将905个在线视频记录与207个自行录制的第一人称视频记录相结合,用于明确请求任务,用于减值援助. 它跨越室内,室外和数字屏幕设置,QA文本在英语和汉语之间大致平衡(分别为744和735交互). 1,479次互动包含1,790个目标,163次互动包含多个目标. 附 录 详细的任务计数,场景和触发分布,持续时间统计,来源,包括视频记录中重复的源身份.

blocks.en: Human annotators specified user context, reference responses, triggers, and response times or valid intervals. A separate group of human reviewers cross-checked the annotations to obtain the final benchmark. This review covers both response content and its temporal relation to the event. Appendix A.4 documents the supplemental consistency audit and review records.
blocks.zh: 人类注释者指定了用户上下文,参考回复,触发,以及响应时间或有效间隔. 一组单独的人类审查人员对说明进行了交叉核对,以获得最终基准。 这一审查涵盖答复内容及其与事件的时间关系。 附录A.4记录补充一致性审计和审查记录。

blocks.en: 5.1 Scene evidence and tool-invocation scores
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 现场证据和工具调用分数

blocks.en:
Figure 3 a shows that removing scene input does not lower Gemini-3.5-Flash’s T1 accuracy. On the same 200 interactions, joint accuracy is 29.50% with scene input and 33.00% without it, with requests and the evaluation protocol held fixed. The paired difference is − 3.50 -3.50 percentage points.
Joint accuracy alone therefore does not establish event-grounded invocation. Appendices D.1.2 and D.4.2 detail the paired ablation and temporal-tolerance analysis.

因此,仅靠共同准确性并不能确定基于事件的援引。 附录D.1.2和D.4.2详细列出了配对的衰竭和时间容忍分析.

blocks.en: The request-only control reveals strong task priors. Gemini-3.5-Flash selects 96.5% of tools from request text and public definitions alone. Emitting these choices after a fixed three-second delay gives 68.0% joint success, the highest of four tested delays. This separate control uses a closed-label output interface and different response opportunities from the main evaluation, so it diagnoses request and timing priors rather than providing a matched model ranking (Appendix D.1.1 ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Reminder coverage under different response policies
blocks.zh: 5.2 不同应对政策下的提醒覆盖面

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 b, giving Gemini-3.5-Flash response history reduces output volume by 58.1%, while both conditions cover 22 of 122 T8-A targets. The matched targets change, with 12 gained and 12 lost. Adding a cooldown reduces outputs further but costs 9.84 percentage points of recall relative to history alone. The policy is implemented by skipping generation calls during the cooldown, restricting the opportunities to cover reminder targets (Appendix D.2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 如图3b所示,给双子座3.5-Flash响应历史,输出量减少了58.1%,而这两个条件都涵盖了122个T8-A目标中的22个. 相应的目标变化,12个增减。 加上冷却会进一步减少产出,但相对于历史而言,只需要9.84个百分点的召回。 该政策通过在冷却过程中跳过生成呼叫来实施,限制了覆盖提醒目标的机会(附录D.2.2.).

blocks.en: Figure 3 c compares event-specific and general instructions in separate runs on the same 122 T8-A episodes. Gemini-3.5-Flash and Qwen2.5-Omni benefit from event cues when a response is requested at an annotated valid time. Under autonomous responding, however, the effects are small and uncertain. The benefit of event cues is therefore clearer when the response time is supplied than when the model must decide when to intervene. Scheduling changes temporal information and response opportunities together, so this comparison does not isolate a planning mechanism.
blocks.zh: 图3 c 比较了同一122个T8-A集上单独运行的针对事件和一般指令. 双子座3.5-Flash和Quen2.5-Omni在附加说明的有效时间请求响应时,从事件提示中受益. 然而,在自主反应下,影响很小,而且不确定。 因此,在提供反应时间时,事件提示的好处比模型必须决定何时进行干预更明确。 时间安排会同时改变时间信息和反应机会,因此这种比较不会孤立规划机制.

blocks.en: 5.3 Complete guidance relative to step coverage
blocks.zh: 5.3 有关分步覆盖的完整指导

blocks.en: On the same 20 three-step T8-C episodes, Gemini-3.1-Pro covers 30 of 60 steps but completes only three sequences. Complete T8-C complements step recall by recording whether all required guidance was delivered.

blocks.en: Figure D.3 (Appendix D.3 ) compares observed completions with a reference based on success rates at each step position. An average of 2.4 complete sequences is expected if successes at different step positions are independent. The observed count is consistent with this reference and does not establish a separate memory or planning failure.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The T1 controls show that request information and response timing can sustain joint success without scene inputs. A tool-and-time score should therefore be accompanied by evidence controls when used to assess event grounding. For streaming tool use ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , varying event occurrence and timing while holding requests fixed would test a stronger requirement than the scene ablation evaluated here.
blocks.zh: T1控制显示,请求信息和响应时间可以在没有场景输入的情况下维持联合成功. 因此,工具与时间的分数在用于评估事件落地时,应当附有证据控制。 对于流线工具的使用(Zhang等人,2026年),在固定请求时,不同事件发生和时间将测试比本文评价的场景衰竭更强的要求。

blocks.en: Response history reduces Gemini-3.5-Flash’s output volume with the same aggregate recall point estimate, while a cooldown reduces both outputs and coverage. These findings connect response-frequency evaluation ( Chatterjee et al., 2026 ) to the policies used during generation. Reporting history access and output rate alongside recall makes this dependence visible. Selectivity additionally requires evaluating the value and cost of interventions beyond the annotated targets, an important direction for future benchmark development.
blocks.zh: 反应历史减少了双子座3.5-Flash的输出量,其总的召回点估计值相同,而冷却既减少了输出,也减少了覆盖. 这些结论将反应频率评价(Chatterjee等人,2026年)与生成过程中使用的政策联系起来。 报告历史和产出率以及回顾,使这种依赖性明显可见。 选择性还需要评价附加说明的目标以外的干预措施的价值和成本,这是今后制定基准的重要方向。

blocks.en: Users may need every guidance step even when individual responses are often correct. Complete T8-C expresses that requirement, while the sequence reference limits attribution of low completion to a separate memory or planning failure. For goal-oriented assistants ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , explicit records of delivered guidance and pending obligations remain a design hypothesis to test through interventions on history and state.
blocks.zh: 即使个别答复往往正确,用户可能需要每一个指导步骤。 完整的T8-C表示这一要求,而序列参考将低完成的归属限制在单独的内存或规划失败. 对于面向目标的助手(Sun等人,2026年),明确记录已交付的指导和待决义务仍然是通过对历史和状态的干预进行测试的设计假设。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Omni-InteractScope, a benchmark for timely and sustained intervention in continuous omnimodal streams. Its 1,479 human-annotated interactions span eight task groups, linking user needs and stream evidence to 1,790 targets that specify response content and timing. Evaluation across 12 models reveals substantial limitations in timely tool invocation, query-free reminders, and complete guidance coverage. These findings underscore the need to assess whether assistants fulfill the response requirements of an interaction, including interventions that remain necessary after an initial answer. Omni-InteractScope provides a shared basis for developing and evaluating assistants that respond to unfolding events and sustain support for continuing user needs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Omni-InteractScope,这是对连续的全模式流进行及时和持续干预的基准。 其1 479次人为附加说明的互动涉及8个工作组,将用户需求和流程证据与1 790项具体列明反应内容和时间安排的目标联系起来。 对12个模式的评价表明,在及时援引工具、免问提醒和完整指导覆盖面方面,存在着很大的局限性。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要评估助理人员是否满足互动的应对要求,包括初步答复后仍有必要采取的干预措施。 Omni 交互 范围提供了共同的基础,用于发展和评价助理人员,以应对正在发生的事件,并持续支持用户的持续需求。

blocks.en:
Local prompted models use greedy decoding; hosted calls use temperature zero.
Gemini-3.1-Pro and Gemini-3.5-Flash retain provider-default thinking, so their limits
are not answer-only token budgets. MiniCPM-o 4.5 uses greedy duplex decoding, 20 spoken tokens per chunk,
and a 30-unit context window. LiveCC uses a repetition penalty of 1.05 and resets
at 28,000 tokens; MMDuet2 resets at 100,000. MOSS-VL uses greedy session generation
with a 512-token setting and a pace of 12 tokens per second. AURA uses temperature
zero and a 512-token limit. Context retention and computation are not equalized
across interfaces. Recorded model revisions and configuration fingerprints are
retained in the reproducibility materials.
